name: Dazzlebirds Orders Import Export For WooCommerce
author: WP SmartStore

sections.description:
WooCommerce Orders Import Export made easy. Dazzlebirds Orders Import/Export for WooCommerce is a powerful, efficient plugin that lets you export and import WooCommerce orders from CSV files. If you are planning to migrate store data, create backups, or generate reports, this plugin provides a simple, structured way to manage your WooCommerce data. Its advanced filter feature lets you select and export or import specific WooCommerce orders and data, helping you manage store data for reporting, backups, and migrations.

The plugin includes bulk import and export, advanced export filters, column mapping, and activity logs; you can view import/export history, helping you manage WooCommerce order data efficiently and accurately.

Key Features

  • Export WooCommerce orders to CSV.
  • Import WooCommerce orders from CSV.
  • Export WooCommerce coupons to CSV.
  • Import WooCommerce coupons from CSV.
  • Filter orders by date, status, customer, product, coupon, or order ID.
  • Import and export order details, including products, billing, shipping, taxes, fees, and refunds.
  • Map CSV columns to the correct WooCommerce fields.
  • Process large imports and exports in batches.
  • View logs for import and export activities.
  • Track previous imports and exports with historical records.
  • Save column mapping templates for future use.
  • Continues imports in the background, even after closing the browser.

What Makes Dazzlebirds Orders Import Export for WooCommerce Different?

  • Import and export both WooCommerce orders and coupons from a single plugin.
  • Preserve order and coupon data during import and export operations.
  • Handle large data transfers with batched processing.
  • Save and reuse column mapping templates for recurring tasks.
  • Access logs and history records for better tracking and management.
  • Designed for store migrations, backups, and reporting workflows.

Premium Version Features

  • Background Import: Continue import operations in the background, even after closing the browser window.
  • Bundle Import & Export: Import and export products, orders, customers, coupons, reviews, categories, and tags in a single operation.
  • Meta Fields Support: Support ACF fields and custom meta fields with advanced field mapping.
  • Excel, XML, CSV, and TSV Support: Import and export data using Excel (.xlsx), XML, CSV, and TSV file formats.
  • Google Sheets Integration: Connect Google Sheets and sync data directly from your spreadsheets.
  • Scheduled Import & Export: Schedule imports and exports to run automatically at specified times.
  • FTP, SFTP, and URL Import: Import files directly from FTP, SFTP, and remote URLs.
  • Advanced Filters & Customization: Apply advanced filters and control how duplicate records are handled during import and export.

How to Export Orders from WooCommerce?

When generating reports, creating backups, or moving data between stores, you must export WooCommerce orders. Dazzlebirds Orders Import/Export for WooCommerce lets you create CSVs from only the order records that matter most to your business. The exported file contains information such as order details, products, billing and shipping details, taxes, fees, and refunds.

  1. Go to WC Data Manager → Export from your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Select Orders as the post type.
  3. Apply the required filters.
  4. Select the fields and columns to export.
  5. Click Export Orders to generate the CSV file.

How to Import Orders to WooCommerce?

Importing existing order records into WooCommerce does not have to be a manual process. Using the Dazzlebirds Orders Import Export for WooCommerce lets you import orders by uploading CSV files and mapping the data to the particular WooCommerce order fields before import. It also facilitates the move of historical order data, or the transfer of orders between WooCommerce stores.

  1. Open WC Data Manager → Import.
  2. Select Orders.
  3. Upload your CSV file.
  4. Match the CSV columns with WooCommerce order fields.
  5. Review the import settings.
  6. Start the import process.

Recommended WP SmartStore Plugins

  • Dazzlebirds Products Import Export for WooCommerce
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/dazzlebirds-orders-import-export-for-woocommerce, or install directly through the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Navigate to WC Data Manager in the WordPress admin menu, then choose the Import or Export tab.
sections.faq:
How do I export WooCommerce orders to CSV?

Go to WC Data Manager → Export, select Orders as the post type, apply any filters (date range, status, customer, product, etc.), and click Export. Your CSV file will be generated in batches and made available for download from the history table.

How do I import WooCommerce orders from a CSV file?

Go to WC Data Manager → Import, select Orders, upload your CSV file, map the columns to the correct WooCommerce order fields using the column mapping UI, and run the import. Use Quick Import for one-click re-imports of previously exported files.

Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce 5.0 or higher must be installed and active for the plugin to work.

Does it work with HPOS (Custom Order Tables)?

Yes. The plugin fully declares HPOS compatibility and reads/writes orders through the WooCommerce data store — not via direct wp_posts queries — so it works correctly whether HPOS is enabled or disabled.

What CSV file formats and delimiters are supported?

CSV is the supported format for both import and export. The delimiter is selectable per operation: comma (default), semicolon, tab, pipe, or a custom character of your choice.

Is there a limit on the number of orders or coupons I can import or export?

No hard limit. The WooCommerce orders import export process runs in configurable batches, so even stores with tens of thousands of orders or coupons can complete the operation without PHP timeouts.

Will importing overwrite my existing WooCommerce orders or coupons?

If an imported order or coupon ID matches an existing record, that record will be updated. A confirmation popup will warn you to create a backup before every import runs.

Can I save my column-mapping setup for future imports?

Yes. After mapping columns during an advanced import, you can save the mapping as a named template and reuse it for future WooCommerce order or coupon import operations.

Can I import products, customers, reviews, or categories with this plugin?

No. This plugin is focused exclusively on WooCommerce orders import export and coupon import export. For products, customers, and other post types, please install the matching plugins in the Dazzlebirds Import Export suite.

Where can I see the history of past imports and exports?

The History tab inside WC Data Manager shows a full log of every import and export operation, including status, record counts, error details, and a download link for exported CSV files.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • WooCommerce orders import and export with line items, billing, shipping, fees, taxes, refunds, and metadata.
  • WooCommerce coupon import and export with discount rules, usage limits, expiry, and product/category restrictions.
  • HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) compatibility.
  • Batched processing with configurable batch size for large stores.
  • Import/export history tracking with optional auto-delete of old records.
  • Save and reuse import column-mapping templates.
  • Backup-before-import warning popup on every import action.
